faqs.question: How long does shipping from Italy to the USA typically take?
faqs.answer: Air Express targets 2-5 business days after export acceptance, and Air Economy targets 5-10 business days. Ocean Freight (LCL) is schedule-based, with exact sailing and transit shown when you request a quote.

faqs.question: Do you handle US Customs clearance?
faqs.answer: The platform is built to guide you through commercial invoice and customs data as part of booking. Full customs brokerage requires a confirmed broker partnership, which is not yet finalised.

faqs.question: Are my shipments insured?
faqs.answer: Optional shipment protection will be offered at checkout once insurance terms are finalised with a partner. It is not yet available on this preview site.

faqs.question: Can I track my shipment in real-time?
faqs.answer: You'll receive milestone updates from pickup through delivery on the tracking page. This preview uses sample tracking data; live carrier integration is not yet connected.

faqs.question: What types of goods can you ship?
faqs.answer: We're focused on commercial and personal goods on the Italy-USA lane. See the Customs page for prohibited and restricted item categories before booking.
